g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud multi-tenant SaaS with Identity Platform tenants, pooled AlloyDB and a silo project

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: Each tenant's users sign in to their own Identity Platform tenant
The HTTPS proxy serves every tenant domain from a Certificate Manager map
The URL map sends shared-tier tenants to the pooled service
which looks up the tenant's tier in the registry
and reads its rows from AlloyDB, isolated by row-level security
A premium tenant's host name routes to its own Cloud Run service
which uses Cloud SQL in the tenant's own project, encrypted with the tenant's key
The sign-up page publishes a new tenant
creates the tenant in Identity Platform and registers it
For premium tenants it runs Terraform in Cloud Build to create a silo project
Both tiers publish usage events, which a BigQuery subscription records for billing
